analytical_dimensions.description: The thinker's position on an owner's question, per text or period
probing_questions: What does the thinker hold on this question, in which text, and does a later text hold it still?

analytical_dimensions.description: A load-bearing concept of the thinker's
probing_questions: Which of the thinker's concepts carries the position, and what would the owner have to do with it?
Against whom is the position built, and is that an opponent of the owner's too?
Between which texts did the thinker's position on an owner's question change, and to what?

analytical_dimensions.description: An owner's question the thinker never addresses
probing_questions: Which of the owner's questions do the held texts not address?

engine_name: One thinker's system, mapped for the owner
problematique: One thinker the owner has chosen to encounter, several of their texts supplied and windowed: their positions on the owner's questions across the oeuvre (early and late, with the turns between), the load-bearing concepts the owner would have to adopt, translate or refuse, the opponents the thinker argues against (shared opponents most of all), and the silences. Every row anchored in the thinker's text with its locus. The owner's questions come from his argument and his stated hypothesis about the thinker, never from the thinker's own agenda.
researcher_question: Across their oeuvre, where does this thinker stand on the questions the owner's model asks, with what concepts, against whom, and where did they move?
